props.purpose: Inspect roof profiles and facade clearance

scene_objects.name: Federation Square - authored approximate sandstone plaza

props.limits: Authored approximate Main Square boundary informed by 2019 precinct diagram, clipped around retained ground-level building envelopes with 1 m margin and road surfaces. Area calibrated to the official 5000 m2 venue figure; boundary still not georegistered or surveyed. Flat .32 m preview level; documented eastward rise of approximately 6 m not yet reconciled with local building datums. Paver sizes, joints and palette authored; artwork not reproduced.

scene_objects.name: Federation Square - authored gable edge trim

props.limits: Authored .9 m metal seam spacing and edge trim fitted to authored gables. Zinc family supported by official design description; actual roof detailing, panel schedule and present-day finish unmeasured.

scene_objects.name: Federation Square - authored gable roof profiles

props.limits: Survey Gable classifications and retained envelope heights. Long-axis ridge and linear planes authored, not measured; captures 2022, not present-day confirmation.

Selected precinct survey envelopes receive authored sandstone/zinc/glass triangles. Five-piece right-triangle groups share one material, informed by documented pinwheel language. Cell dimensions, ratio adaptation, panel schedule and present-day cladding distribution authored; not an exact facade reconstruction. Survey silhouettes retained; architectural roof forms and precinct boundary need further reconciliation.

finding: Per-structure relative datum removes between-building minimum elevation differences. Current plaza slope cannot be reconciled by changing paving alone.
limits: Source minima are building geometry extents, not verified entrance thresholds. A common datum must be verified before rebuilding precinct. Existing generic grouped roof/window meshes also need coherent updates; do not translate survey objects alone.
